best_idea: Reveal map cells only when three rays from offset points agree on the same object and on its distance, so a gap or a pillar cannot reveal what the player cannot see, and keep the N most recently explored zones.
decision_why: Take the three-ray agreement test, the floor-under-head, view and sweep order, the 5 Hz gate that skips while the map is open, and the keep-N memory; view length is zone data; fix the donor's sweep gap, missing-hit and tie defects first; explored state goes to the character ledger.
acceptance: Walking a zone at 375 px fills in map cells in view and the floor just ahead, and a cell seen only through a pillar gap stays unrevealed; a unit test asserts a 0.2-unit gap refuses the reveal; the character's explored set is restored after re-login from the ledger.
